title: Farm stand pickup switch
brief:
Prepare a public notice for prepaid produce-box customers at Foxglove Farm Stand. On Saturday, August 8, pickups will move to the covered loading porch behind the stand because the front lot is hosting a pottery sale. The pick-up window stays 9 a.m. to noon. Customers should enter from Mill Lane, follow the green arrows, and give the order surname at the porch table. Staff can bring boxes to cars on request at the table. Unclaimed boxes can be collected Sunday from 10 a.m. to noon at the usual counter. The notice will appear at the front gate and on the order board.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

7c976ac2c95396b7.text:
**Foxglove Farm Stand**  
**Prepaid produce-box pickup moves to the back porch on Saturday, August 8**

The front lot will host a pottery sale on Saturday. You can pick up your prepaid produce box at the covered loading porch behind the stand during the usual hours of **9 a.m. to noon**.

Enter from **Mill Lane** and follow the green arrows to the porch table. Give staff the surname on your order. If you’d like someone to bring your box to your car, please ask at the table.

If you miss Saturday pickup, you can collect your box **Sunday from 10 a.m. to noon** at the usual counter.

# Foxglove Farm Stand  
## Saturday, August 8 · Prepaid Produce Box Pickup

Pick up your prepaid produce box from **9 a.m. to noon** at the **covered loading porch behind the stand**. The front lot will be hosting a pottery sale.

Enter from **Mill Lane** and follow the **green arrows** to the porch. Give the surname on your order at the porch table. If you’d like staff to bring your box to your car, ask at the table.

# Produce-Box Pickup Moves to the Back Porch on Saturday, August 8

**For prepaid produce-box customers**

On Saturday, August 8, pick up your box at the covered loading porch behind the stand. The front lot is hosting a pottery sale that day.

**Pickup hours are unchanged: 9 a.m. to noon.**

**How to find us**

1. Enter from Mill Lane.
2. Follow the green arrows to the porch.
3. Give your order surname at the porch table.

**Need a hand?** Ask at the table and staff will bring your box to your car.

**Can't make it Saturday?** Unclaimed boxes can be collected on Sunday, August 9, from 10 a.m. to noon at the usual counter.

Thank you for your patience, and enjoy the pottery sale while you're here.

*Foxglove Farm Stand*
